settings.body: Performance Skins paired with the apparel they were built to move with. One order, one studio-ready set — for hot pilates, heated yoga, and anything that leaves the floor slick.
A kit pairs Performance Skins with the pieces we make for heated work, chosen so the grip, the sweat and the fit all agree. No building it one piece at a time and hoping it works together.
